scope: Same existing private 15m RTH Terminal bars and predeclared four symbols SOXX SMH QQQ AMD; no new vendor endpoint/trades/publication rights
parent: 3h_medium: MACD(8,21,5), Stoch RSI(14), >=2 prior80bar histogram RMS opposite polarity plus recent Stoch K<=20, one bearish histogram lobe/episode, 26 observed RTH-hour expiration

conditions.parent_only: first completed 3H candle after arm on which 3H histogram remains negative and improves and 3H Stoch K rising and >=D. Entry at first subsequent observed 15m open
conditions.parent_and_30m_pivot: latest closed parent turn state AND causal confirmed 30m price pivot, next observed 15m open
conditions.parent_and_15m_pivot: latest closed parent turn state AND causal confirmed 15m price pivot, next observed 15m open
conditions.timed_delay_null: Parent-only first-turn entry plus delay of 0,1,2,4,8 observed RTH hours before next 15m open, one entry per episode, skip if 26h expiry; no change in MACD/stoch thresholds

risk: fixed original 1.5% stop from each corresponding actual synthetic next-open entry, 25% partial at 2%, fee5bp each side, initial stop never widened, 52 observed RTH hour timed exit and 15m OHLC low-first execution, next-open signal
primary_metric: mean net per original parent extreme episode including no-trigger as cash, with missing exit unknown; no indicator turns on incomplete higher candles
secondary_metrics: same-episode parent's earlier turn vs confluence later return and lag
calendar-week block bootstrap for paired effects
analyses: Do not select best delay to claim validation. Compare parent-only to 15/30 conjunction and stratified deterministic delays, pooled using per-symbol equal weighting and week-block dependence
publication: GitHub research-only numbers/code; raw Terminal OHLCV private
